chosen_titles.rationale: Title III (Legislative Branch; Commissions) houses Florida's legislative-branch lobbying-disclosure regime in Chapter 11 (sections 11.045-11.062: registration, compensation reporting, contingency-fee prohibitions).

Title X (Public Officers, Employees, and Records) houses the executive-branch lobbying-disclosure regime in Chapter 112 Part III - Code of Ethics (section 112.3215 registration/reporting before the executive branch, plus related provisions administered by the Commission on Ethics).

notes: FL has the canonical dual lobbying-disclosure regime - legislative-branch in Title III Ch. 11, executive-branch in Title X Ch. 112 Part III. Both titles required.
